display.purpose: Hero headline only. Playfair Display; the single largest statement on a page.

headline.purpose: Section titles. The recurring Playfair serif drumbeat that structures a page.

title.purpose: Sub-section and card headings within body content. Inter semibold; company names may step up to Playfair.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and lists in Inter. Cap measure at 65 to 75ch.

label.purpose: Small supporting text, descriptions, captions in Driftwood Grey.

shadows.name: overlay-soft
shadows.purpose: Navigation bar, dropdown menus, popovers. Navy-tinted quiet lift for true overlays only.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs only (themselves a last resort).

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for color, opacity, and transform-based state transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button and link hover/focus state changes.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: FadeIn / scroll-reveal entrances (translateY + opacity). Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default brand CTA. Solid First Coast Blue, calm, no lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#229FD9; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:1rem; line-height:1; padding:14px 32px; min-height:48px; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#1E8FC4; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #229FD9; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Warm second action used only beside a primary CTA. Inlet Orange.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#F16622; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:1rem; line-height:1; padding:14px 32px; min-height:48px; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#D9551A; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #229FD9; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: On-Dark Button
components.description: White-on-navy action for use on navy or photographic backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-on-dark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#18457C; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:1rem; line-height:1; padding:14px 32px; min-height:48px; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-on-dark:hover { background:#F0F4F8; } .ds-btn-on-dark:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat, bordered content surface. No resting shadow; border deepens on hover.
components.html:
Integrated Expertise

Real estate, construction, development, maintenance, and travel, coordinated under one group across the First Coast.
components.css: .ds-card { background:#FFFFFF; color:#18457C; border:1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius:8px; padding:24px; transition:border-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color:#18457C; } .ds-card-title { font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.25rem; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0 0 8px; color:#18457C; } .ds-card-body { font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-weight:400; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.65; letter-spacing:-0.01em; margin:0; color:#707070; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Clean-stroked field. Blue ring and border on focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; height:40px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#0A0A0A; border:1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 12px; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.4; transition:border-color .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#707070; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #229FD9; outline-offset:2px; border-color:#229FD9; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Editorial serif navigation link. Navy at rest, blue on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-navlink { font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif; font-weight:500; font-size:1rem; color:#18457C; text-decoration:none; transition:color .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-navlink:hover { color:#229FD9; } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #229FD9; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small wayfinding label. Used sparingly (for example 'A Family of Companies').
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-block; background:#229FD9; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:Inter,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:0.8125rem; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:0.02em; padding:4px 12px; border-radius:6px; }

narrative.overview: This is the front door to a family of Northeast Florida property companies, and its only job is to make a sophisticated visitor (a referral attorney, a wealth manager, a family office, a prospective client) feel that this group is real, established, and built to outlast any single deal. The aesthetic is a quiet holding company: authority expressed through restraint, whitespace, and hairline structure rather than volume. It presents itself as a lifecycle atlas, a calm directory mapping land-through-maintenance as one integrated system, never as a hard-selling service provider. The palette is coastal but never touristic: a deep institutional navy anchored to a clear First Coast blue, with warm accents used sparingly as wayfinding, not decoration. Typography pairs a Playfair Display serif with Inter for clean body text. Surfaces are flat and bordered, not floating. The whole system should read closer to a land-and-trust company or a university endowment than to a real-estate franchise or a venture-funded app.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet authority over flash; restraint is the signature.
Coastal palette anchored to deep navy, warm accents rationed.
Serif display (Playfair) for permanence, Inter for clarity.
Flat, bordered surfaces; shadows reserved for true overlays.
Generous, varied vertical rhythm; nothing cramped, nothing shouting.
Credibility framing throughout: inquiry and by-appointment, never 'book now'.

rules.name: The One Bright Voice Rule
rules.body: First Coast Blue is the only color allowed to draw the eye, and it appears on roughly 10% of any screen or less. Navy is the field; blue is the signal. Orange and gold are emergency wayfinding, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The Earned-Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm accents (orange, gold) appear only where they guide an action or distinguish a sibling company. Never as a gradient, a background wash, or a mood.

rules.name: The Serif-for-Permanence Rule
rules.body: Every page-structuring heading is Playfair. The serif is what signals an institution rather than a startup; never substitute a bold sans for a section title.

rules.name: The Quiet Caps Rule
rules.body: If small uppercase labels are introduced, track them open (around +0.08em) and keep them in navy or grey. Loud, tight, colored caps read as marketing.

rules.name: The Flat-Content Rule
rules.body: Cards, panels, stat bands, and images carry no resting shadow. If a content surface needs separation, use a hairline border or a Mist background, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Float-Means-Overlay Rule
rules.body: A shadow is a promise that the element is temporarily above the page and will go away (a menu, a dialog). If it is permanent page content, it does not get a shadow.

dos: Do lead with Deep Harbor Navy and reserve First Coast Blue for roughly 10% of the surface (The One Bright Voice Rule).
Do set every page-structuring heading in Playfair Display (The Serif-for-Permanence Rule).
Do keep content surfaces flat with 1px Hairline borders; reserve shadows for true overlays only (The Flat-Content Rule).
Do cap body measure at 65 to 75ch and use generous, varied vertical rhythm (section-y 48px to 64px).
Do frame all actions as inquiry or by-appointment, per the credibility-over-conversion principle.
Do name the real geography (First Coast, St. Augustine to Amelia Island) and keep imagery genuinely Northeast Florida.
Do keep the five company cards structurally uniform and let navy carry them.
donts: Don't use purple or blue gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism, or the hero-metric template (big number plus small label plus supporting stats). These are the SaaS or startup cliches PRODUCT.md forbids; the current navy-to-blue gradient bands and the '5 / 20+ / 500+ / 100%' stats bar are exactly this pattern and should be replaced.

Don't state metrics the pre-launch group has not earned ('20+ Years Experience', '500+ Projects Completed'). This violates the pre-launch-honesty principle; empty-until-real beats impressive-but-false.
Don't turn the five company accent colors into a rainbow grid of identical cards. Let navy lead and use each accent only as a small mark.
Don't drift toward a real-estate franchise look: no stock agent headshots, no 'search homes now' bars, no listing grids, no sold-sign badges.
Don't use beach-tourist kitsch (palm-tree clip art, sunset-orange washes, exclamation marks) or generic corporate-template blandness (stock handshake photography).
Don't put a colored border-left or border-right stripe greater than 1px on cards, callouts, or list items. Use full hairline borders or a Mist background.
Don't add resting shadows to content (no shadow-2xl on buttons, no hover:shadow-xl lift on cards).
Don't use pure #000 or #fff as design intent where a tinted neutral will do; lean on Ink, Canvas White, Mist, and Hairline.
Don't reach for a modal as the first answer; exhaust inline and progressive alternatives.
